flags.why: Bán niên belongs to formal reporting language rather than ordinary casual speech, as noted in [this usage guide](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/ban-nien-tieng-anh-la-gi).
Bán phần means partial generally, rather than specifically covering costs, as illustrated by [hospital usage](https://www.benhvien108.vn/gioi-thieu-vien-phau-thuat-tieu-hoa.htm).
The Northern tag incorrectly excludes established Southern usage of this name, documented by [a Southern cake maker](https://banhnguyenkim.com/san-pham/banh-da-lon-la-dua/).
Bánh lăng denotes caramel custard rather than a tart, as described by [a bakery](https://lalacake.com/cua-hang/combo-6-hop-banh-flan-truyen-thong-lala-cake/).
The example refers to caramel custards, so translating bánh lăng as tarts names a different dessert.
flags.fix: She bought two caramel custards for the children.
